technical_quality: Adequate quality. 'L' side marker in the upper-right image corner confirms conventional orientation (patient's right on image left). Penetration adequate (thoracic vertebral bodies visible through the heart); inspiration adequate (about 9 posterior ribs); minimal rotation. Scapulae partially project over the lateral upper lung fields. Apices and costophrenic angles included; inferior edge cuts through the upper abdomen.

abnormalities.finding: Rounded, mass-like opacity in the right perihilar / mid zone with an enlarged, dense-appearing right hilum (approx. 4-5 cm)
Increased medial opacity in the right upper zone with thickening of the right paratracheal stripe / widened right upper mediastinum, contiguous with the hilar density
Small dense (possibly calcified) nodular opacities at the right hilum, suggestive of calcified lymph nodes
Generalised relative increased density of the right hemithorax compared with the hyperlucent-appearing left lung
Prominent, unfolded/tortuous aortic knob and descending thoracic aorta (age-related ectasia)
Cardiac silhouette at the upper limit of normal / borderline enlarged (CTR roughly 0.5)
Degenerative changes of both acromioclavicular joints and shoulders

description_zh: 正面（疑為PA）胸部X光，投照品質尚可，正中線可見三枚圓形外物影（疑為心電圖貼片扣或衣物鈕扣），無胸管或引流管。右側肺門增大且密度增加，右中肺野肺門旁可見約4–5公分之圓形腫塊狀陰影，並延伸至右上肺野內側，使右側氣管旁條紋增厚、上縱膈增寬；右肺門另見數個小點狀高密度影，疑為鈣化淋巴結。左肺相對透亮且清晰，雙側肋膈角銳利，無明顯肋膜積液或氣胸；心影大小約在正常上限，主動脈弓突出且迂曲，雙側肩鎖關節見退化性變化。
